test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 1 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and fourth term is related to third term.

UNLIKE : ENILKU :: FLOWER : RLWOEF :: CAVITY : ?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

** First and sixth alphabets are interchanged & third and fourth alphabets are interchanged.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbd3458d2bb982b5c55c9d08d568b58e7fb7269ecc0b1f1948290a3e659043c3.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0167904e051c90767856ca0b3a58fb8c2dd26dc7c22ba3366b1df15eda2dc9f.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb99e8221c2e8dcc25b6a8a07e0bc862d37131267f2e33b514e36660b7fc29fa.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
